candidate_evidence.quote: This multicenter, Phase 1b/2 study is being conducted to determine if the experimental cell therapy is safe, tolerable and can delay the return of cancer

coder_notes: Only investigational therapy is a gene-modified gamma-delta T cell product (excluded type). Arm labels copied without the 'Phase 2 Arm A'/'Phase 1b and Phase 2' descriptors that follow the colon.
